rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley where tenant shares kitchen or bath with landlord.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election

exemptions.description: Exemption does not apply if landlord did not reside at the property at the start of the tenancy

rules.quote: Where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord, the unit will be exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.requirement: Rental units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord are exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord resided at the property prior to the tenant.
rules.title: Exemption for units with shared kitchen/bath facilities

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election

key_values.name: Minimum rental debt threshold
key_values.text: one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR

rules.quote: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.requirement: Eviction for nonpayment of rent is no longer permitted for rental debt of less than one month's Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size in the Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR area.
rules.title: Minimum rental debt threshold for nonpayment evictions

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election
rules.quote: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.requirement: A landlord may no longer evict a tenant for failure to sign a new fixed term lease.
rules.title: Prohibition on eviction for failure to sign new lease

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election
rules.quote: Material lease terms only include mutually agreed upon lease terms. The alleged violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant's behavior was unreasonable. The landlord's notice to the tenant to stop the violation (which is required before the landlord can serve an eviction notice) must specify the lease term, and describe the violation and resulting harm in enough detail for a reasonable person to understand.
rules.requirement: In any notice terminating a tenancy for a lease breach, the landlord must clearly describe the alleged breach. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant's behavior was unreasonable, and may not evict tenants for lease breaches that do not cause the landlord any actual harm.
rules.title: Requirements for eviction based on material lease term violations

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election

key_values.name: Filing deadline
key_values.text: three business days after the tenant was served with the document

rules.quote: Any notice terminating a tenancy must contain a statement that advice about the notice is available from the Rent Board, the current phone number for the Rent Board's Housing counseling services, and the current address of the Rent Board's website. The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
rules.requirement: Eviction notices must contain certain information directing tenants to the Rent Board, and copies of eviction notices and eviction lawsuits must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.
rules.title: Eviction notice content and filing requirements

rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley with tenancies starting on or after December 20, 2024.

key_values.name: Notice delivery deadline
key_values.text: within fifteen days of the start of the tenancy

rules.quote: For tenancies started on or after December 20, 2024, landlords must, within fifteen days of the start of the tenancy, give the tenant written notice containing the following information: The existence of and scope of the Rent Ordinance; the tenant's right to petition against certain rent increases, if applicable; whether the unit is exempt from rent control; and any other partial exemptions which may exist. If the property has an interior common area that all tenants have access to, the landlord must post the notice in the common area.
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide tenants with a Notice of Tenant Rights at the start of a tenancy and post the notice in any indoor common area if the property has one.
tenancy_conditions: Tenancy must have started on or after December 20, 2024
rules.title: Notice of Tenant Rights requirements

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All fully covered residential rental units in Berkeley.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election

exemptions.description: Landlords with banked (unused) AGAs from previous years may implement a rent increase greater than 5% to raise rent to the rent ceiling
exemptions.quote: This cap does not prevent a landlord who has "banked" (unused) AGAs from previous years from implementing a rent increase that is greater than 5% in order to raise the rent to the rent ceiling.

rules.quote: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.requirement: Annual General Adjustments are capped at a maximum of 5%.
rules.title: Annual General Adjustment cap at 5%

rules.coverage_text: All fully covered residential rental units in Berkeley with tenancies starting on or after February 6, 2024.

exemptions.description: Landlord may charge separately for utilities if the utility service is separately-metered and the lease requires the tenant to place the utility in the tenant's name
exemptions.quote: the utility service is separately-metered and the lease requires the tenant to place the utility in the tenant's name

rules.quote: For tenancies starting on or after February 6, 2024, a landlord may charge a tenant in a fully covered unit for utilities only if either: the cost of the utilities are part of the base rent, or the utility service is separately-metered and the lease requires the tenant to place the utility in the tenant's name.
rules.requirement: Utility charges must be a set amount incorporated into the base rent at the start of a tenancy unless the utility is separately metered and the account is in the tenant's name as specified in the lease.
tenancy_conditions: Tenancy must have started on or after February 6, 2024
rules.title: Utility charges in rent for fully covered units

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election
rules.quote: Tenants who live on certain properties now have an enforceable right to create tenant associations, and engage in organizing activities. Landlords and tenant associations are required to confer in good faith in an attempt to address any issues such as: landlord-tenant relations, rent increases, habitability concerns, and other issues of common interest.
rules.requirement: Tenants have an enforceable right to organize and may petition for a decrease in rent if this right is violated.
rules.title: Tenant right to organize

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All fully covered residential rental units in Berkeley.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election
rules.quote: Landlords can only file a petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements (they can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements).
rules.requirement: Owners may only petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements, rather than planned capital improvements.
rules.title: Rent increases limited to completed capital improvements

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All partially covered government-owned or subsidized residential rental units in Berkeley.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election

key_values.name: Reporting deadline
key_values.text: within 15 days of the tenancy's start date

rules.quote: Owners of partially covered units must now report new tenancies to the Rent Board within 15 days of the tenancy's start date. Owners must also update tenancy information annually during the registration billing cycle.
rules.requirement: Owners of partially covered units must now report new tenancies to the Rent Board within 15 days of the tenancy's start date.
rules.title: Tenancy reporting requirements for partially covered units

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley subject to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance requirements.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election
rules.quote: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.requirement: Yearly adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance payments are now mandatory.
rules.title: Annual adjustment to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance

rules.anchor_quote: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley subject to tenancy reporting requirements.
rules.effective_expression: following Measure BB passage in November 2024 election

key_values.name: Reporting deadline for fines
key_values.text: fifteen days of the tenancy start date

rules.quote: Measure BB gives the Rent Board the power to impose fines for failing to report new tenancies within fifteen days of the tenancy start date.
rules.requirement: The Board has the power to adopt fines for any noncompliance with the Ordinance's registration requirements including failure to report tenancy information in a timely manner.
rules.title: Board authority to impose fines for tardy tenancy reporting
